source_mapping.wait_path: WaitForMainThreadQueryV1 cancels a still-queued request when its caller-side timeout expires
source_mapping.publication_path: DriveMilitaryPreparationSummaryPrivateProbeV1 maps every non-completed, non-infrastructure wait result to application_main and publishes the failure

root_cause.detail: The private probe submitted one valid mailbox request and immediately blocked the bridge worker for 1000 ms. No application-main pump claimed that queued slot inside this arbitrary caller-side window, so WaitForMainThreadQueryV1 cancelled it before execution. The failure publication therefore described the worker timeout mapping, not absence of a proven application-main owner.

minimal_private_fix.behavior: Keep queued/executing requests in flight across bridge heartbeats and publish only after observing a terminal mailbox state; do not call a cancelling wait from the unsolicited heartbeat path.

integration_follow_up.change: Replace the private DriveMilitaryPreparationSummaryPrivateProbeV1 synchronous 1000-ms wait block with the new non-cancelling private mailbox observer, then reclaim only after it publishes a terminal result.
